description: Term-centric sweep for Task 737: one word per concept. Collisions found by audit 2026-10-14: Label=Tag (es, it, tr, hr), Reservoir=Source (cs), Label=Description (fr), Elevation=Head (he).

entries.complaint: English Source names two things: a water-quality source node (Find scope, Source type, Source quality) and the origin of water in Source trace / Source share. Czech needs two words: Dávkování and původ.
entries.resolution: Not an English defect: Tom's standing rule already splits the analysis (Source trace) from the percentage (Source share), and a language may render the node and the origin with two words. Recorded in glossary source-trace.

entries.complaint: Etiqueta is the map Label; Código is the survey code; no standard Spanish GIS word for Tag was free. Marcador chosen as best fit, not native-verified.
entries.resolution: Recorded in glossary term 95 (Tag) as es marcador, 2026-10-14. Told Tom in that day's report; his word overrides it.
